name: [Cyanotype] Oldest queued job older than 30 minutes
message:
{{#is_alert}}Runnable jobs have been waiting more than 30 minutes (the gauge is 0 when the queue is empty, so this only fires while work is queued).{{/is_alert}}
Check the worker container (restarts, OOM), its logs, and the memory-budget waits widget. During a very large import a long queue is normal; compare with throughput.
